en.title: My Hope Is Built on Nothing Less
en.author: Edward Mote
stanzas:
My [E]hope is built on [A]nothing [E]less
Than Jesus' blood and [B7]righteousness;
I [E]dare not trust the [A]sweetest [E]frame,
But wholly [B7]lean on [E]Jesus' name.

When darkness veils His lovely face,
I rest on His unchanging grace;
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.

His oath, His covenant, His blood
Support me in the whelming flood;
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

When He shall come with trumpet sound,
Oh, may I then in Him be found;
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.

notes: Four stanzas and refrain — Timeless Truths and hymnary's representative text agree on the set and the wording. Mote's original ran longer (hymnals note six stanzas); the extra stanzas dropped out of hymnal use, are not in either consulted source, and are not shipped. Tune SOLID ROCK (William B. Bradbury, 1863); meter as hymnary lists it (8.8.8.8.8.8.8 — four stanza lines plus the refrain's three; Timeless Truths prints the same). Key: the hymnal key is F (Timeless Truths score); E is the nearest preferred guitar key (one semitone down; G would be two up). Chords are Bradbury's harmonization simplified: lines 1/3 alike over I-IV-I, lines 2/refrain-line-2 half-cadence on B7, full cadences close line 4 and the refrain.
